evidence.reason: Commit bfaabe1d2275353daa3f15ef64b1c4afd3af7a05 ("unlock collect-history") moves the long collect-history/GitHub pagination path out of the queue-lock dispatch and also bounds git operations, addressing the lock-held network work cited by the finding. The current code no longer shows the collect-history branch doing github_sources inside execute, and the remaining triage/import git fetches are under the bounded git path.
